digest.component_or_area: event-based metrics reader over durable ticket store
propositions: Read-only derivations must extract agent-process metrics (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass-rate, rework-windows, reopen-recovery, revert-recovery) from the durable event store including compaction-retired events using a hybrid data-access strategy: raw event files for multi-occurrence metrics and compiled state for terminal-value metrics.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted via event_sort_key with retired events included via is_active_event, while metrics requiring only terminal values (first-pass-rate via last_reopened_at absence, revert-recovery via reverts[] content) must read compiled state from reduce_ticket.

Unit tests must validate that a ticket with two distinct open→in_progress sessions yields attempts_per_ticket==2, a closed→open→closed transition 3 days apart counts in rework_within_days(7) but not 10 days apart, and reverts targeting STATUS/COMMITS events are counted while COMMENT-reverts are not.

Empty date ranges must return None (Unavailable), populated ranges with zero qualifying events must return 0 (measured zero), and all metrics must register with source="structural" and confidence="high".
